## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0326-power-of-three.py</code></summary>

```python
class Solution:
    def isPowerOfThree(self, n: int) -> bool:

        rem = n % 3
        if n == 1:
            return True 
        
        if rem != 0 or n <= 0:
            return False

        while  n > 1 and rem == 0:
            n = n // 3
            rem = n % 3
        
        if rem != 0 and n > 1:
            return False
        
        return True
```

</details>
